title: Velocity Profiler
text: Generate velocity profile of vehicle path given kinematic constraints, 5 inputs, 2 outputs; {Maximum longitudinal acceleration (m/s^2)} sets the maximum longitudinal acceleration, {Maximum longitudinal deceleration (m/s^2)} sets the maximum longitudinal deceleration, {Maximum allowable speed (m/s)} sets the maximum allowable speed along path, {Maximum longitudinal jerk (m/s^3)}, {Maximum lateral acceleration (m/s^2)}, {Show Times output port} sets the output times of arrival for velocity, {Sample time} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Directions
ports.summary: Driving directions along path M -by-1 vector of 1s (forward motion) and –1s (reverse motion)

ports.name: CumLengths
ports.summary: Cumulative path lengths M -by-1 vector of monotonically increasing real-valued elements

ports.name: Curvatures
ports.summary: Signed path curvatures along path M -by-1 real-valued vector

ports.name: StartVelocity
ports.summary: Longitudinal velocity of vehicle at start of path real scalar

ports.name: EndVelocity
ports.summary: Longitudinal velocity of vehicle at end of path real scalar

ports.name: Velocities
ports.summary: Velocity profile along path M -by-1 real-valued vector

ports.name: Times
ports.summary: Vehicle times of arrival for velocity profile M -by-1 real-valued vector

params.name: Maximum longitudinal acceleration (m/s^2)
params.values: Maximum longitudinal acceleration of vehicle 3 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Maximum longitudinal deceleration (m/s^2)
params.values: Maximum longitudinal deceleration of vehicle 6 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Maximum allowable speed (m/s)
params.values: Maximum allowable speed along path 10 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Maximum longitudinal jerk (m/s^3)
params.values: Maximum longitudinal jerk 1 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Maximum lateral acceleration (m/s^2)
params.values: Maximum lateral acceleration 1 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Show Times output port
params.values: Output times of arrival for velocity profile off (default) | on

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time of block -1 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code Generation (default) | Interpreted Execution
